lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots arranged in roughly horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, with vertical and horizontal spacing increasing toward the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal rows of circular spots, forming a subtle grid-like pattern on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Prominent horizontal linear feature running from the upper gill margin across the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with higher intensity on the dorsal side of the ridge and shadow on the ventral side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, bright white L-shaped or angular scar is visible on the dorsal-lateral surface, positioned superior to the first and second gill slits.
other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin displays a high-density cluster of smaller, more irregularly distributed high-luminance blobs compared to the more uniform and larger spots on the primary lateral flank.
